predictor.notes: Parsimonious, interval-consistent predictor for quantities 1..1000, in GBP pence—not a uniquely identified exact schedule. It reproduces both exact approvals (50: 92092; 200: 104693), and applying the disclosed 1.08 quantization reproduces all eight observed estimates at 1, 125, 300, 350, 400, 550, 700 and 1000. Three affine regimes suffice; additional segments are not required by the observed intervals. Start 174 is a near-continuous join chosen within the unresolved 126..200 gap; start 326 is a midpoint assumption within 301..350, where the observations establish a decrease. Neither breakpoint is known exactly. Coefficients remain non-unique, and nonlinear or additional discontinuous behavior between observations cannot be excluded. Exact reconstruction of all 1000 prices is not identifiable from this allowance; the approximately 4% estimate-rounding uncertainty is not a global prediction-error bound.
